<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Solomatova (2016), Table 7 and MINUTI analysis: coupled HS/LS reference branches inferred from measured compression trajectories, including the cited experimental datasets. Model decomposition does not make these ab-initio fits.
- **Equation:** Table 7 and MINUTI discussion: third-order Birch-Murnaghan high-spin and low-spin reference branches in a coupled spin-crossover fit.
- **V0:** Table 7 HS column: 77.1 A^3 per conventional B1 cell.
- **K0:** Table 7 HS column: 162 GPa.
- **K0 prime:** Table 7 high-spin K0' column.
- **Original dataset:** Solomatova et al. refit the P-V data of Chen et al. (2012), DOI 10.1029/2012JB009162.
- **Fit relationship:** The paired branches, transition pressure, and transition width form one source spin-crossover model; Peritheos currently stores only the independently executable reference branches.

</details>

## Observation datasets

### mg065fe035o\_chen\_2012\_table1\_pv

- **Description:** Complete 36-row 300 K compression series for the FP35 specimen printed in Chen et al. Table 1.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Chen; Jackson; Sturhahn; Zhang; Zhao; Toellner
    - **Year:** 2012
    - **Source:** Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
    - **Volume:** 117
    - **Locator:** B08208
    - **DOI:** 10.1029/2012JB009162
- **Source location:** Table 1, page 4
- **Associated EOS records:** mg065fe035o\_solomatova\_2016\_hs\_bm3\_reference\_1; mg065fe035o\_solomatova\_2016\_ls\_bm3\_reference\_2
- **Uncertainty:**
    - **Reported as:** Parenthetical pressure standard deviations and approximately 0.5% volume uncertainties printed in Table 1; the ambient pressure has no printed uncertainty.
    - **Covariance:** not\_reported
- **Notes:** The catalog's Mg0.65Fe0.35O label is nominal. Chen et al. measured (Mg0.654(1)Fe0.330(1)Ti0.016(1))O; the audit retains this composition distinction and uses Solomatova's nominal x=0.35 spin count only for its reconstruction.
